Pickable Models are a series of sets exclusive to the LEGO Store, introduced in 2012. All the models are available for one month, and are sold in Pick-a-Brick containers, with instructions available separately.

page.overview:
What is Pickable Models?

Pickable Models are a series of sets exclusive to the LEGO Store, introduced in 2012. All the models are available for one month, and are sold in Pick-a-Brick containers, with instructions available separately.
